On Tue, Jan 18, 2022 at 11:50 AM Meral Karan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi all
Just dropping it down to the DRG folks for a moment. It's like people are reading our minds! Diana and I have been
saying that we would really like to raise this to the Administrator's attention and I agree we need to loop in Josh and
Lauren (CSM) in particular too. Eventually this really has to be more of a whole of Agency issue because
mis/dis/malinformation (MDM) is impacting health, climate change, and economic growth portfolios and certainly the
digital space too.
We (Johnny, Lauren, Josh, Diana and I) already planned to meet tomorrow and touch base on where we are on MDM
approaches and where we think we need to go. We could then also brainstorm how to approach this ask so we can do
a presentation to SP. Ro, I added you and David to that meeting. (Sorry I should have done so earlier!)
Thanks,
Meral
Meral Karan

+ Sophia, who is going to run point for the front office on this issue.
I have been offline quite a bit for the past several days dealing with COVID-related issues, and here's a
summary from Gideon of SP's thinking on this from a meeting I missed last week.
"On the disinformation front -- this just came up quite extensively in small group again today. this isn't clearly
USAID's capabilities are. So that probably means engaging the DRG and ITR folks (maybe others) to
done (if anything) in places like Ethiopia, Ukraine, and Nepal to counter disinformation. This would be mini-case
studies to better understand what we do/ don't do. And then ultimately the bigger piece will be the interagency --
SP wants to engage Jake to set up a process on this."
